name: Elanaria
summary: On the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus, Elanaria prepares fighters for danger across Kalimdor. She tests their strength against foes such as Vorlus Vilehoof and the Shade of Elura.

sections.title: A Sentinel of the Terrace
sections.body: Elanaria trains warriors on Darnassus's Warrior's Terrace. Since the night elves joined the Grand Alliance, she has guided Sentinels and fighters from other peoples through the dangers facing their lands.

sections.title: Trials of Iron and Spirit
sections.body: Elanaria demands discipline, endurance, and strength proven in battle. She sends seasoned fighters after threats in Teldrassil and Darkshore, including the satyr Vorlus Vilehoof and the Shade of Elura. She also works with Smith Mathiel so proven warriors can be armed for war.

faq.answer: Elanaria is a night elf warrior mentor on the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus. She sends fighters on trials across northern Kalimdor.
You can find Elanaria on the Warrior's Terrace, Darnassus's northern district for military training and defense.
Elanaria sends fighters after Vorlus Vilehoof and the Shade of Elura, and directs them to Smith Mathiel for arms.

faq.q: Why does Elanaria send fighters against Vorlus Vilehoof?
faq.answer: Vorlus Vilehoof is a dangerous satyr whose corruption threatens the northern wilds. Elanaria sends capable fighters to kill him, protecting the forests and testing their strength in battle.
Smith Mathiel is an armorer in Darnassus. Elanaria directs warriors to Mathiel for equipment suited to frontline combat.

faq.q: Does Elanaria interact with non-night elves?
faq.answer: Yes. Elanaria guides Alliance warriors who come to the Warrior's Terrace for training.

angles.text: As a warrior, you can seek Elanaria's guidance on the Warrior's Terrace and prove your strength in battle.
As a night elf, you can help Elanaria drive satyrs and restless shades from your ancestral lands.
As an Alliance soldier, you can look to Elanaria in Darnassus for guidance and arms as you defend Alliance interests across northern Kalimdor.
